```{=html}
<style>
.bl-widget{margin:1rem 0 1.6rem}
.bl-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.bl-tools .btn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem}
.bl-tools .btn.bl-on{background:var(--site-accent-dk);border-color:var(--site-accent-dk);color:#fff}
.bl-check{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin:0 .6rem 0 .2rem}
.bl-legend{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin:.35rem 0 .6rem}
.bl-boards{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem;align-items:flex-start;margin:.4rem 0}
.bl-boards svg{border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px}
.bl-card{border-radius:8px;padding:2px;border:2px solid transparent;transition:border-color .12s}
.bl-card.bl-live{border-color:var(--site-accent)}
.bl-boards .ld-label.bl-live{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:3px}
.bl-each .bl-card svg{width:215px}
.bl-abc{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;gap:.5rem 1rem;margin:.3rem 0}
.bl-abc .btn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem;margin-top:.6rem}
.bl-abc>div{min-width:0}
@media (max-width:600px){.bl-abc{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:.3rem}.bl-abc .btn{align-self:flex-start;margin-top:0}.bl-abc>div{max-width:none!important}}
.bl-abc .btn.bl-on{background:var(--site-accent-dk);border-color:var(--site-accent-dk);color:#fff}
.bl-scale{border-left:3px solid var(--site-accent);padding-left:1rem}
.bl-notes{margin:.2rem 0 1rem}
.bl-anim{margin:.3rem 0 .5rem}
.ls-on,.ls-on *{fill:#d6336c;stroke:#d6336c}
/* the bar itself (fixed to the foot of the window, one row, what does not fit goes behind "Options") is PlayBar's: apps/shared/playbar.js */
#bl-bar label,.playbar-pop label{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--parch-dim);margin-right:.3rem}
#bl-bar select,#bl-bar input[type=number],.playbar-pop select,.playbar-pop input[type=number]{max-width:15rem;font-size:.85rem;padding:.15rem .3rem;border:1px solid var(--parch-edge);border-radius:4px;background:#fff}
#bl-bar input[type=number],.playbar-pop input[type=number]{width:4.2rem}
#bl-bar input[type=range],.playbar-pop input[type=range]{width:7rem;vertical-align:middle}
#bl-status{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--parch-dim);width:11rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
</style>
<div id="bl-bar">
  <span data-pri="3" data-pri-live="6"><label for="bl-key">Key</label><select id="bl-key"></select></span>
  <span data-pri="7" data-pri-live="8"><label for="bl-dots">Label notes with</label><select id="bl-dots"><option value="tone">Chord tones (R, 3, ♭7)</option><option value="name">Note names</option></select></span>
  <span data-pri="4" data-pri-live="5"><label for="bl-feel">Feel</label><select id="bl-feel"></select></span>
  <span data-pri="1" data-pri-live="2"><label for="bl-tempo">Tempo</label><input type="range" id="bl-tempo" min="40" max="220" step="2"> <input type="number" id="bl-tempo-n" min="40" max="220" step="2" aria-label="Tempo in beats per minute"></span>
  <span data-pri="2" data-pri-live="3"><input type="checkbox" id="bl-loop"> <label for="bl-loop">Loop</label></span>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="bl-stop" disabled>■ Stop</button>
  <span id="bl-status" aria-live="polite" data-pri="6" data-pri-live="1"></span>
</div>
<script src="/apps/shared/tonality.js?v=10"></script>
```
